author: Yann Lanthony <yann.lanthony@gmail.com>
message:
[scene_file] serialize only valuable node attributes

* save only valuable attributes: non-connected with non-default value inputs (the only type of attribute that can not be deduced)
* save only attribute properties:
   - related to identification (key)
   - not contained in the node definition (value, if non-default)
* when loading a scene:
   - node attributes are now initialized based on node definition (plugin.json)
   - attributes values from node definition are stored as default value
   - attributes values are only updated if corresponding data was saved in the scene file (Actions.hpp)

author: Yann Lanthony <yann.lanthony@gmail.com>
message:
support multiple graphs in one Scene

* Scene:
   * now works with a list (QQmlObjectListModel) of named graphs
   * one graph (Scene.graph) is considered as the current one
   * serialize graphs list in the scene file
* Cache:
   * move cacheUrl to Scene
   * default cache folder is now by default a .meshroom_cache folder next to the scene file (so cache is shared between scene's graphs)
* Commands:
    * new scene commands: add/duplicate/remove graph
    * move command-related graph functions inside Graph class (instead of Actions.hpp)
    * commands store graphs indexes instead of pointers, since Graph objects can be deleted
* Update OpenMVG template to match those changes
